name: Skills
description:
Rebalanced skills:

1) Resistance - reduces 15/30/40% damage from spells
2) Logistics - increases hero's movement points over land by 5/10/20%
3) Scouting - increases sight radius by 1/3/5
4) Estates - increases income by 250/500/1000
5) Necromancy - 5/10/15% creatures killed in combat can be brought back from the dead as skeletons
6) Intelligence - increases hero's maximum spell points by 20/40/60%
7) Sorcery - increases damage inflicted by hero's spells by 10/20/30%
8) Mysticism - allows to regenerate 5/15/30 mana points per day
9) Learning - increases earned experience by 25/50/75% and knowledge/magic skills/all skills by 1. Additionaly increases random primary skill by 1 upon visiting Library of Enlightenment.
10) Ballistics - increases effectiveness of Catapult and increases its health points by 250/500/1000
11) Artillery - increases effectiveness of Balista and increases its health points by 50/100/250
12) First Aid - increases effectiveness of First Aid Tent, increases its health points by 25/50/75 and reduces damage it obtains from spells by 50/75/100%. The tent can remove negative effects from creatures.

Eagle Eye is banned.
author: wnukos
